none: PAS NLM-AB22D2: Roman Coin: Sestertius of Faustina II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin.Sestertius of Faustina II (147-175), mint of Rome. Sear vol. 2 no. 4717 suggests a sestertius issued 154-156 citing RIC vol. 3 no. 1383. Reece period 7. Obverse description: Female bust coiffed with small bun and draped right. Obverse inscription: FAVSTINA AVG PII AVG [FIL]. Reverse description: Female draped and veiled standing left, right hand extended; S in left field.…
